content_of_post_to_comment: Healthcare insurance in the US is so wild. It’s actually hilarious that we’ve all just accepted that we have to pay $1000 per month so that we only have to pay a max of (an additional) $13,000 per year in medical costs, for a total of $25,000! Wow such a deal, we are truly benefiting from this flawless system!!
comment: The real cost isn't just the premiums and deductibles. It's that people may delay getting care because they're afraid of the bill, making the system expensive even when you barely use it.
